question: In which infection is vancomycin treatment recommended orally ?:

options.opa: In infections caused by carbapenemase-producing Klebsiella pneumoniae.
options.opb: In pseudomembranous colitis due to Clostridium difficile.
options.opc: In gastritis by Helicobacter pylori and always combined with other antimicrobials.
options.opd: In typhoid fever that does not respond to conventional treatments.
